name: Tin-Qin
source:
New Moon God
Before the Heavenly Divine Abode, Tin-Qin was an ordinary person, but due to certain circumstances, she ceased to be one.

After the events she experienced, she met Mizuno and thus managed to enter the Abode.
Tin-Qin had to go through many stages to become a God.
Now she is one of the members of the "top".
